item.title: Rewrite that Rails app, the 2026 edition
item.description: Is it time to rewrite that Rails app?
item.content:encoded:
Most of the conventional wisdom around rewrite vs all the alternatives came down to simple economics: the time to rewrite an entire application was more expensive than the alternatives: refactoring, optimizing, or even just running the application on a more powerful server.

But most of that conventional wisdom came around before LLM-coding.

By now, most of us know that Bun was rewritten in Rust, mostly by AI. While the estimated $165,000 worth of tokens it took to rewrite sounds staggering, it's comparable to some American developer's (median) yearly salary. As of this writing, there's already significant payoff from it.
